ApplicabilityClaim.description: Immutable attribution of an instantiated scientific claim.

basis.description: Fitted, recommended or validated region; none for unknown/unrestricted/union.

call.description: Distinguishes actual bound applications, including derived arguments.

coverage.description: Joint whole-interval application, only for a verified declared interval.

evidence.description: Evidence source; absent for an undeclared claim.

form.description: Form whose actual application demanded this evidence.

id.description: Absent exactly for undeclared evidence, which is unknown.

layer.description: Evidence layer, distinct from a mathematical domain.

owner.description: Declared scientific family or model owner.

owner_lineage.description:
Checked nominal owner and its entity-kind ancestors, in most-derived order.
Non-kind owners have only themselves; callers cannot author this witness.

reason.description: Explicit unknown reason, never a numerical predicate result.

records.description: Distinct scientific records selected by this application.

ApplicabilityInput.description: Numerical inputs are recorded in the lowering's canonical physical units.

quantity_type.description: Actual physical quantity type; values use its canonical unit.

value.description: Actual value at the demanded application; the wire retains explicit IEEE evidence.

ApplicabilityObservation.description: One typed observation, including alternative evidence which was not required.

admitted.description: Whether the low-level evidence gate admitted this required claim.

extrapolation_allowed.description: Whether leaving this particular claim's region was permitted.

inputs.description: Actual inputs of this claim application.

instance.description: Bound assembly instance, populated by the executing consumer.

permissions.description: Authorizing declarations that matched this claim's exact target.

required.description: This claim was required, rather than a nonwinning union alternative.

unknown_allowed.description: Both permissions remain independent even for a mixed dependency result.

ApplicabilityPermission.description: Authorization retains its declaration and scope, with fixed named targets.

allow_extrapolation.description: Independent permission for leaving a declared region.

allow_unknown.description: Independent permission for absence of evidence.

scope.description: Declaring lexical consumer scope, not the claim's owner.

target_kind.description: Named records or declared scientific families.

targets.description: Exact admitted target identities; inheritance never widens this set.

BoundaryDiagnostic.description: Stable structured cause shared by Rust and the public error projection.

applicability.description: Complete scientific evidence on demanded paths, including refused claims.

causes.description: Ordered retained cause envelopes, preserving repeated aggregate occurrences.

class.description: Machine-readable disposition; callers never parse the message.

code.description: Detailed semantic identity, authoritative over every coarse projection.

locations.description: Available source locations. Empty means unattributed, not a guessed source.

observations.description: Values observed while checking the contract.

rule.description: The violated named contract, not a replacement for source identities.

severity.description: Error, warning or information; a warning never makes a model invalid.

sources.description: All affected authored identities, in deterministic order.

stage.description: Operation boundary, such as selected admission or provider registration.

validity.description: The lineage of a rejected authored validity predicate; absent on every other finding.

Observation.description: Evidence distinguishes absence, finite numerical/physical values and nonfinite failures.

oneOf.description: A finite numerical observation (not necessarily a physical magnitude).
Explicitly tagged nonfinite numerical failure evidence.
Finite physical evidence bound to its complete immutable quantity contract.
Ordered physical operand/free-index contracts, preserved structurally.

OperandContract.description: A complete registered quantity type plus its free-index obligations.

indices.description: Ordered bound-index, domain and entity-kind identities.

PhysicalObservation.description: Finite physical evidence bound to its complete immutable quantity contract.

fit_id.description: The fit whose goal was assessed.

model_id.description: The definition whose selected goal was assessed.

case_id.description: The case declaration the step solved: its root when that root is a case or a test (a case with an oracle), otherwise absent. A fit names the one case all its experiments solve, if they share one.

fit_id.description: The fit the step solved; absent for a modeling solve or simulation.

instance_id.description: The instance the step's root became: the root declaration's own identity for an ordinary solve or simulation, the experiment's instance for a fit experiment. Absent for a fit, which spans its experiments' instances.

model_id.description: The specialized definition the step solved: the root declaration its model specializes. A fit names the one definition all its experiments specialize, and none when they specialize different ones.

run_id.description: The run that produced the row: minted once when a run starts or a job is enqueued, and shared by the job's retried attempts. It names the execution, not the request's content.

RuntimeSolveRunsFieldCommitmentItem.description: A row or nested value projected from the registry declaration.

RuntimeSolveRunsRow.description: A row or nested value projected from the registry declaration.

case_id.description: The case declaration the step solved: its root when that root is a case or a test, otherwise absent.

instance_id.description: The instance the step's root became: the root declaration's own identity, or a fit experiment's instance.

model_id.description: The specialized definition the step solved: the root declaration its model specializes.

run_id.description: The run that produced the row: minted once when a run starts or a job is enqueued, and shared by the job's retried attempts. It names the execution, not the request's content.

SourceLocation.description: Authored location attached by the owner that has the source map.

path.description: Definition or document path, never a backend-local node identifier.

revision.description: Immutable source interpretation context; absence is explicitly unattributed.

source.description: Original semantic occurrence or instance identity.

start.description: UTF-8 starting byte offset, when supplied by the parser/compiler.

ValidityLineage.description:
What a rejected authored validity predicate guards (ADR-0123 Outcome 4, Plan 23 H5): its
layer and the declaration stating it; for the form and data layers the form it belongs
to, the parameter sets whose values bound it and the form's declared arguments it
constrains; for the closure layer the model members its range bounds. A fixture's
expected validity failure is matched against this lineage, not against a rule text.

form.description:
The form: the function declaration whose evaluation was rejected; absent on the
closure layer.

layer.description:
The form layer (a function's own domain), the data layer (a declared envelope) or
the closure layer (an annotated range).

members.description: The model members a closure range bounds; empty on the form and data layers.

sets.description: The table rows or entities whose values bound the predicate, in order.

source.description:
The form itself, the relation or kind declaration declaring the envelope, or the
closure range's annotation.

variables.description: Positions of the constrained arguments among the form's declared arguments.

description: Immutable semantic projection shared by Arrow, Python and publication.

accuracy_goals.description: Retained engineering outcomes; historical no-goal products have an empty collection.

assessments.description: Final physical closure and usability decisions, never recomputed by an exporter.

computation.description: Dynamic or fitting outcome, with candidate evidence separate from qualification.

diagnostics.description: Source-attributed final errors and unavailable fit diagnostics.

lineage.description: Complete request lineage, independent of this execution's unique identity.

solves.description: Algebraic outcomes, including requested steps that were not attempted.
